decision_rationale: This is a primary model paper on plant DNA sequence modeling, but the provided evidence is biological sequence only and does not include natural-language text or a text-bio bridge. The model is described as pretrained, but a clearly generative mechanism is not explicit enough to resolve that criterion.
evidence_snippet: "a multispecies plant DNA LM pretrained on a curated set of 16 evolutionarily distant angiosperm genomes"; "self-supervised pretraining on large-scale genomic datasets"; "cross-species prediction of functional annotations"; "captured broad evolutionary conservation and DNA sequence grammar"
